quality.basis: 崩溃差分：驱动程序调用 DoubleToAscii，标准答案取自测试用例

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/double-conversion/vulnerability_FZ_22/pov.txt; adapted: test/cctest/test-dtoa.cc:140 DoubleToAscii(1.5, PRECISION, 10, ...) (DtoaVariousDoubles, test_dtoa is among the aborting tests in run.out) as the driver line "dtoa PRECISION 10 1.5". Checked locally: the injected build aborts on the Bignum::RawBigit assertion (bignum.cc), the secure one prints digits=1500000000 length=10 point=1.)

category5.design: Clamp on a zero bignum is reached only by the bignum dtoa paths of DoubleToStringConverter, which have no harness or CLI; a driver calls the public DoubleToAscii with the PoV's values. The driver itself never aborts on the secure build (it refuses non-finite values and digits outside the ToFixed/ToPrecision limits), so the crash rule is sound.
